design.title: Remodel primary, wet room
design.summary: A doorless wet room on one waterproof floor: plaster-look porcelain, a ceiling rain head, a bench and body sprays.
scope: New construction, a remodel, or design and build: Remodel
Just the tub or shower, or the whole room: Just the tub or shower
A shower, or a tub with a shower over it: A shower
How big is the space: another size
How do you step in: Barrier-free roll-in
A window in the shower: No window
Which look is closest: Spa wet room
What are the walls made of: Traditional tile
Where do the bottles go: Horizontal niche
A seat: Bench along the long wall
When do you need the materials: In 14 to 20 days

checklist.text: Confirm the drain location under the floor
Confirm the valve's position and the supply lines' size and condition
Confirm the walls are straight and sound where the new walls go
Check the walls and floor for water damage once they're open, before ordering the rest
Confirm the valve has an outlet for the sprays and the supply can feed them with a head running
Confirm the joists' direction and depth under the shower for the drain and the floor's slope
Confirm the bench's framing and blocking fit the wall and floor
